name: http-fetch
description: Make HTTP requests (GET/POST/etc.) and return normalized response metadata and content.

HTTP_FETCH_DEFAULT_USER_AGENT.description: Optional default User-Agent header to send when none is provided in inputs.

HTTP_FETCH_PROXY_URL.description: Optional HTTP(S) proxy URL to route requests through.

headers.description: Optional request headers as a simple key/value map.

body.description: Optional request body (for POST/PUT/PATCH, etc.). Sent as-is. For JSON, send a JSON-stringified payload and set Content-Type accordingly.

max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to read from the response body. Responses larger than this should be truncated.

response_type.description: Hint for how the response body should be returned.

status.description: HTTP status code returned by the server.

url_final.description: Final URL after redirects (if follow_redirects is true).

headers.description: Normalized response headers as a key/value map.

body_text.description: UTF-8 text response body when treatable as text (response_type=text or auto-detected).

body_json.description: Parsed JSON response body when response_type=json (or auto detects JSON).

body_base64.description: Base64-encoded response body for binary responses (response_type=bytes or auto detects binary).

truncated.description: True if the response body was truncated due to max_bytes.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. INPUT_INVALID, REQUEST_FAILED, TIMEOUT, RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE).

details.description: Optional structured context about the error (e.g. status code, URL).
